title: Softly Now the Light of Day
description: Softly Now the Light of Day in Tonic Solfa to PLEYEL'S HYMN, doh is G: the solfa with the words, staff notation, 3 verses and a piano.
about: These words were printed without an author's name in Hymns for Christian Devotion, compiled by John G. Adams and Edwin H. Chapin (Boston, 1846), as hymn 955 of its twenty-second edition (1853), “Evening Hymn. Ps. 141:2”.
The book printed the words without tunes, marked Sevens (7.7.7.7), to be sung to any tune of that metre. This page sets them to PLEYEL'S HYMN; any other Sevens tune fits them as well.
underlay: Soft-ly now the light of day Fades up-on my sight a-way; Free from care, from la-bor free, Lord, I will com-mune with thee.

lines: Softly now the light of day
Free from care, from labor free,
Lord, I will commune with thee.
Soon, for me, the light of day
Then from sin and sorrow free,
Take me, Lord, to dwell with thee.

licence: Public domain: anonymous words in print by 1853.
credits: Words anonymous, public domain, as printed in Hymns for Christian Devotion (1853); set to PLEYEL'S HYMN by NoteFusion, as words-only hymn books were sung.
